lines.text: What happens when substances react? Their atoms rearrange, creating entirely new substances. This is the fascinating world of chemical reactions!
Why are some substances acidic and others basic? Their ions determine how they behave, something we can explore using the pH scale.
Metals can lose electrons, while non-metals can gain them. But metals can also react with their environment and undergo corrosion.
And carbon? Its ability to form strong bonds and long chains creates an extraordinary variety of compounds.
Chemistry is everywhere. Discover the science behind everything!
